note: Station 5, the White Loom (PLAN.md section 7: new, split from v2's caelum; built 2026-11-12 at the plan's site, 1697,1176). Lake Nim (the model: 124 cells, about 500 km2, level 240 m, bed 218 m, class WX) fills the page's west edge; the playa rises east from its shore at 240 m to 250 m at the page's east edge, under the scarp that climbs to 340-460 m 8 km east. kin: the Great Chasm's kit for the playa's salt tufts and the desert set on the rising ground; fauna: kits/fauna's loom group (the halite sifter). The site record below is the plan's data; build.py reads only kin, core, fauna and base.
name: The White Loom (station 5): Lake Nim's shore and its halite playa, the salt crust over brine, the brine pools and their mats, the halite sifters at a pool, a salt-cutters' camp
